entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I bought this helmet, and I just get so overwhelmed with websites and policies. I need to return it, but I'm not sure how.
I can certainly help you with that process. Just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, a preference, I guess? The color just wasn't what I thought it would be. I never even took it out of the packaging, the box unopened and sitting in my closet. I'm just so confused by the whole thing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can definitely help. Getting the right gear is important, and with a helmet, proper fit and comfort are key to your safety. Do you have your order number handy?
Umm, let me see... yes, it's VF-8675309.
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Trail Helmet was delivered 57 days ago.
Is that bad? I told you, I get so confused and lost track of time. I was worried it was too late.
Not at all. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a return shipping label to the email on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for making that so simple, Charlie.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to hear it. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
